<script>
// Move the product row by exactly one card per click; the browser handles scrolling and snapping.
(function () {
  var track = document.querySelector('.pc-track');
  if (!track) return;
  var prev = document.querySelector('.pc-prev'), next = document.querySelector('.pc-next');
  var reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  function step() {
    var card = track.querySelector('.card-tool');
    return card.getBoundingClientRect().width + (parseFloat(getComputedStyle(track).columnGap) || 0);
  }
  function update() {
    prev.disabled = track.scrollLeft <= 2;
    next.disabled = track.scrollLeft + track.clientWidth >= track.scrollWidth - 2;
  }
  function move(dir) {
    track.scrollBy({ left: dir * step(), behavior: reduce ? 'auto' : 'smooth' });
    setTimeout(update, 450); setTimeout(update, 900); // refresh the arrows once the scroll has settled
  }
  prev.addEventListener('click', function () { move(-1); });
  next.addEventListener('click', function () { move(1); });
  track.addEventListener('scroll', update, { passive: true });
  track.addEventListener('scrollend', update);
  window.addEventListener('resize', update);
  update();
})();
</script>
